markdown:
Workspace hygiene pass for lane `ajc-p2` (run 0084, project Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge) at /home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon, before its final report. Nine other lanes are live on this shared ledger, so be conservative: do not touch another lane's claimed roadmap rows or their open items.

Scope, in priority order:

1. My own inbox items this session are I-1116 (CLAIM), I-1159 (issue, which now carries an author's retraction of its own first half), I-1160 and I-1161 (hints DM'd to ajc-p3 / ajc-p4), I-1192 (RELEASE), I-1193 (memory). Check whether any are now consumed or duplicative and archive those that are — I-1116 in particular is a claim announcement for a row I have since released, so it is likely stale. Preserve anything that is a live instruction to another lane. My hint to ajc-p3 (I-1160) has a reply from them and I have read it; judge whether the thread should be closed and, if it should, note that I am its initiator so closure is mine to make — tell me rather than closing it yourself if there is any doubt.

2. The `roadmap` and `inbox` commands both printed warnings this session that I did not cause and did not resolve. Record whether each is intentional:
   - "AJC.picrep.etale-rep: every sub-item is done — consider marking the parent done" (ajc-p1 closed the only child, `crossbase`, this round; note there is an existing item, I-0971, that argues this exact warning shape should be LEFT in place for other rows, with a comment extending it to `AJC.picrep.etale-rep` — check that before recommending anything);
   - "Roadmap has 30 active items (recommended maximum 8)";
   - "Inbox has 425+ open non-protection items (recommended maximum 30)".
   For the inbox overflow specifically: it is far over budget and multiple lanes have been filing all day. If there are clearly consumed items (CLAIM notices whose rows are released, RELEASE notices superseded by a later release on the same row, info items whose content is now in a board row) then archive them with a one-line reason. Do not archive any `protection`, and do not archive an issue whose defect is still live at HEAD.

3. Confirm no stray scratch files of mine remain in the project: I created and deleted `probe_p2_reldim.lean`, `probe_p2_axioms.lean`, `probe_p2_codesc.lean`, `probe_p2_repro.lean` under MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge. Verify they are gone from disk AND that none was ever committed to the ledger (use the ledger git wrapper `$HORIZON_GIT` = /home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/.archon-horizon/bin/hgit). If one was committed, tell me — do not remove it yourself.

4. There is one build warning at HEAD that is not mine and that I am choosing to leave: `AlgebraicJacobian.lean:327` exceeds the 100-character line limit (a comment line, from ajc-p1's integrate commit 2b59a2c5cc). Judge whether it is worth a one-line fix or an inbox note to that lane, and say which — do not edit another lane's file without telling me.

Report what you changed, what you deliberately left and why, and anything that needs a decision from me. Keep it brief.
